rules.requirement: Every interactive generation or compile result must include a source-bound review HTML artifact.
rules.prevention: Attach multiview generation to generate, compile and build3d before returning the result.

rules.requirement: Generation must create the current review artifact without surprise GUI launches; an explicit user view request must open that reviewer through the reviewer-first boundary.
rules.prevention: Keep generation tools at review_launch=never by default, then use aicad_open_review_request with review_launch=always for an explicit desktop view request.

rules.requirement: Headless operation must degrade safely without falsifying review completion.
rules.prevention: CI, AICAD_NO_GUI and missing-display detection return an explicit skipped result while preserving the HTML artifact.

rules.requirement: Opening a review must never imply engineering acceptance.
rules.prevention: Retain reviewOnly=true, accepted=false, ruleEnabled=false and packagingGated=true in generated review packages.

rules.requirement: Every 2D and 3D review surface must provide one synchronized coordinate-system visibility switch whose last choice survives reopening.
rules.prevention: The switch controls all 2D axes, origin marks and the rotating 3D triad together; store only the boolean visibility preference and never use screen pixels as model coordinates.

rules.requirement: Every generic open, show, view, inspect, or look-at request must open the current content-bound interactive drawing modifier, never a raw PDF, image, DWG, DXF, STEP, SolidWorks, or KiCad artifact.
rules.prevention: Route the request through aicad_open_review_request; require the HTML role marker interactive_drawing_modifier and keep open_native_cad=false by default even when a raw artifact path is supplied.

rules.requirement: A native CAD host may open only after an explicit user request for native CAD editing or output, and only after the interactive modifier has launched.
rules.prevention: Require open_native_cad=true plus an allowlisted existing CAD path; record reviewer-first order and block the native launch if the modifier did not launch.

rules.requirement: A review HTML must prove that it is a current interactive drawing modifier rather than an arbitrary wrapper or stale showcase page.
rules.prevention: Validate data-artifact-role=interactive_drawing_modifier and bind the modifier manifest to the exact current source artifacts before opening.

rules.requirement: An interactive drawing modifier must expose source-bound vector CAD entities with semantic IDs, separate wide hit geometry, layer identity, model measurements, and a typed correction preview; a raster PDF/image browser never satisfies the modifier contract.
rules.prevention: Validate cad-view SVG, view-hit geometry, data-view-entity-id, data-source-id, data-source-subobject, a semantic entity catalog, measurement inspector, reviewOnly=true, accepted=false, and the correction surface before launch. Reject role-marker-only HTML.

rules.requirement: Raster content may appear only as a declared secondary underlay beneath a complete selectable vector entity set; it may never be the sole or authoritative drawing geometry.
rules.prevention: When an IMG exists, require data-vector-source-bound=true, data-raster-only=false, and more selectable vector hit targets than raster images. Keep source hashes and CAD layer semantics attached to every selectable entity.
